description.zh: 涩谷十字路口是全球最繁忙的十字路口之一，每次绿灯约有3,000人同时穿行。周边聚集了东京最前沿的时尚、美食和娱乐，是现代都市文化的缩影。
description.en: Shibuya Crossing is one of the world's busiest intersections — some 3,000 people cross at once on each green light. The surrounding district is Tokyo's epicentre of fashion, food and urban pop culture.

zh: 都市
购物
夜生活
en: Urban
Shopping
Nightlife

zh: 日均逾100万人次的涩谷十字路口
忠犬八公像，东京最著名的集合地点
涩谷Sky展望台360°俯瞰东京夜景
en: Shibuya Crossing sees over 1 million people daily
Hachiko statue — Tokyo's most famous meeting spot
Shibuya Sky observation deck with 360° night views

admission.zh: 街区免费，涩谷Sky展望台约2,000日元
admission.en: Street free; Shibuya Sky observation deck ~¥2,000

tips.zh: 涩谷十字路口最佳观景点是涩谷站二楼星巴克或对面的 Mag's Park 观景台，无需消费。
tips.en: The best free vantage point for the crossing is the second-floor Starbucks in Shibuya Station or the Mag's Park terrace opposite.

description.zh: 小笠原群岛位于东京以南约1,000公里的太平洋上，从未与大陆相连，孕育了大量独一无二的动植物，被称为「东方加拉帕戈斯」。2011年列入UNESCO世界自然遗产。
description.en: The Ogasawara Islands, 1,000 km south of Tokyo in the Pacific, have never been connected to a continent and harbour extraordinary endemic species — earning the nickname 'Galapagos of the Orient'. UNESCO Natural Heritage since 2011.

zh: 世界遗产
自然遗产
生物多样性
en: UNESCO Heritage
Natural Heritage
Biodiversity

location.zh: 东京都小笠原村（父岛、母岛）

zh: 195种特有植物，大量特有鸟类和昆虫
父岛周边海域：海豚、鲸鱼、绿海龟可近距离观察
与东京都本土仅靠一艘25.5小时航程的定期船连接
en: 195 endemic plant species, plus endemic birds and insects found nowhere else
Waters around Chichi-jima teem with dolphins, whales and green sea turtles
Accessible only by a single ferry with a 25.5-hour sailing from Tokyo

admission.zh: 岛上景点大多免费，须购买往返船票约50,000日元
admission.en: Most island sites free; round-trip ferry ticket ~¥50,000

tips.zh: 小笠原丸定期船每6天一班，需提前预订；岛上没有空港，时间充裕才能成行。6—8月海况最宜人。
tips.en: The Ogasawara Maru ferry sails every six days — book well ahead. There is no airport; allow a full week minimum. June–August offers the calmest seas.

name.zh: 国立西洋美术馆（勒·柯布西耶建筑作品）
name.en: National Museum of Western Art, Tokyo (Le Corbusier)

description.zh: 东京上野的国立西洋美术馆由建筑大师勒·柯布西耶设计，1959年落成，是其「无限成长博物馆」概念的杰出体现。作为全球17处勒·柯布西耶建筑作品的一部分，于2016年共同列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: The National Museum of Western Art in Ueno, Tokyo, designed by Le Corbusier and completed in 1959, is an outstanding realisation of his 'Museum of Unlimited Growth' concept. As one of 17 Le Corbusier works worldwide, it was jointly UNESCO-listed in 2016.

zh: 世界遗产
勒·柯布西耶
现代建筑
en: UNESCO Heritage
Le Corbusier
Modern Architecture

location.zh: 东京都台东区上野公园

zh: 勒·柯布西耶在亚洲唯一的作品，螺旋形「无限成长」概念
前庭罗丹雕塑园：含《地狱之门》《思想者》等名作
馆藏西方绘画自文艺复兴至20世纪，逾4,500件
en: Le Corbusier's only work in Asia; the spiral 'Museum of Unlimited Growth' concept
Foreyard sculpture garden featuring Rodin's Gates of Hell and The Thinker
Collection of over 4,500 Western artworks from the Renaissance to the 20th century

admission.zh: 常设展500日元；特别展另行收费

tips.zh: 上野公园内集中了多处博物馆和美术馆，可安排「上野博物馆巡礼」半日游。每月第二、四个周六免费开放常设展。
tips.en: Ueno Park clusters several museums — plan a 'Ueno museum crawl' for a rewarding half-day. The permanent collection is free on the 2nd and 4th Saturday of each month.

description.zh: 浅草是东京最具江户风情的下町街区，核心是建于公元645年的浅草寺——东京历史最悠久的寺庙。雷门大灯笼、仲见世购物街与五重塔构成东京最具代表性的风景之一。
description.en: Asakusa is Tokyo's most atmospheric shitamachi (old downtown) district, centred on Senso-ji — the city's oldest temple, founded in 645 AD. The Kaminarimon lantern gate, Nakamise shopping arcade and five-storey pagoda form one of Tokyo's most iconic sights.

zh: 寺庙
江户风情
购物
en: Temple
Edo Culture
Shopping

zh: 浅草寺雷门：东京最著名地标之一，大红灯笼重达700公斤
仲见世商店街：250米长、日本最古老的商店街之一，售卖传统工艺品和小吃
合羽桥道具街：日本最大的餐饮器具专业市场，含仿真食物模型
en: Kaminarimon (Thunder Gate): the 700 kg red lantern is one of Tokyo's most photographed icons
Nakamise arcade: 250 m of Japan's oldest market streets lined with traditional crafts and snacks
Kappabashi 'Kitchen Town': Japan's largest restaurant supply market, famous for plastic food replicas

tips.zh: 清晨六七点是拍摄雷门最佳时机，游客极少。浅草寺御签若抽到凶签，请系在签棚上再离开，是当地习俗。
tips.en: Arrive at 6–7 am for near-deserted shots of Kaminarimon. If your omikuji fortune slip is bad luck, tie it to the rack and leave it — that's the local custom.

description.zh: 上野公园是东京面积最大的公园之一，也是全日本著名赏樱圣地。公园内汇聚东京国立博物馆、国立科学博物馆、国立西洋美术馆、上野动物园等顶级文化机构，素有「东京的博物馆区」之称。
description.en: Ueno Park is one of Tokyo's largest parks and Japan's most celebrated cherry-blossom viewing site. Its grounds house the Tokyo National Museum, National Museum of Nature and Science, National Museum of Western Art, Ueno Zoo and more — earning the nickname 'Tokyo's museum quarter'.

zh: 公园
博物馆
赏樱
en: Park
Museums
Cherry Blossoms

zh: 东京国立博物馆：日本最大博物馆，馆藏逾11万件，含大量国宝级文物
不忍池：湖中弁天堂倒映水面，每年夏季荷花盛开
上野动物园：日本最古老的动物园，以大熊猫著称
en: Tokyo National Museum: Japan's largest museum with 110,000+ items, including numerous National Treasures
Shinobazu Pond: the mid-lake Benzaiten shrine and its summer lotus blooms are an iconic sight
Ueno Zoo: Japan's oldest zoo, celebrated for its giant pandas

admission.zh: 公园免费；各博物馆另行售票，约600—2,000日元

tips.zh: 3月下旬至4月初樱花盛开期间，上野公园内约1,000株染井吉野樱同时开放，是东京最壮观的赏樱地点。
tips.en: During late March–early April cherry-blossom season, roughly 1,000 Somei-Yoshino trees bloom simultaneously — making this Tokyo's most spectacular hanami spot.

description.zh: 新宿是全球最繁忙的车站所在地，日均旅客逾350万人次。东侧的歌舞伎町是亚洲最大的娱乐街区，西侧林立着摩天大楼与东京都厅免费展望台。新宿御苑则将江户风格庭园与法式、英式花园融于一体。
description.en: Shinjuku is home to the world's busiest station, with over 3.5 million daily passengers. The east side hosts Kabukicho, Asia's largest entertainment district; the west side features skyscrapers and the free Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building observation deck. Shinjuku Gyoen merges Edo gardens with French and English garden styles.

zh: 夜生活
都市
公园
en: Nightlife
Urban
Garden

zh: 东京都厅展望台：免费俯瞰东京全景，天气好可远眺富士山
新宿御苑：58公顷花园，日本最佳赏樱地点之一，约1,300株樱树
歌舞伎町：亚洲最大娱乐区，东急歌舞伎町塔等新地标林立
en: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building: free observation deck with panoramas including Mt Fuji on clear days
Shinjuku Gyoen: 58-hectare garden with ~1,300 cherry trees — one of Japan's finest hanami spots
Kabukicho: Asia's largest entertainment district, now anchored by the new Tokyu Kabukicho Tower

admission.zh: 都厅展望台免费；新宿御苑500日元
admission.en: Government building deck free; Shinjuku Gyoen ¥500

tips.zh: 新宿西口地下通道被称为「迷宫」，初次前来建议从南口或东口出站。新宿御苑禁止携带酒精饮料进入。
tips.en: The underground passages at Shinjuku West Exit are famously labyrinthine — first-timers should exit via South or East Gate. Shinjuku Gyoen prohibits alcohol.

description.zh: 原宿是日本青年流行文化的发源地，竹下通聚集了最前沿的街头时尚。相邻的表参道大道两侧是全球顶级奢侈品牌精品店，有「东京香榭丽舍」之称。代代木公园的绿意与明治神宫的庄严肃穆亦近在咫尺。
description.en: Harajuku is the birthplace of Japan's youth street culture; Takeshita Street packs the latest in quirky fashion into a single narrow lane. Neighbouring Omotesando Avenue — tree-lined and flanked by luxury boutiques — is dubbed 'Tokyo's Champs-Élysées'. Yoyogi Park and the serene Meiji Shrine are minutes away.

zh: 时尚
街头文化
购物
en: Fashion
Street Culture
Shopping

location.zh: 东京都涩谷区原宿·表参道

zh: 竹下通：170米长的街道聚集了200多家店铺，是日本流行文化风向标
表参道：欧美奢侈品牌与日本设计师品牌共存，安藤忠雄设计的表参道之丘购物中心
代代木公园：54公顷的都市绿洲，周末常有免费艺术表演
en: Takeshita Street: 200+ shops in 170 m — Japan's pulse-point for youth trends
Omotesando: international luxury maisons alongside Japanese designer labels; Tadao Ando's Omotesando Hills
Yoyogi Park: 54-hectare urban green space with free outdoor performances on weekends

tips.zh: 竹下通周末极为拥挤，建议周一至周五上午前往。原宿站旁的明治神宫值得单独安排半天参观。
tips.en: Takeshita Street is overwhelmingly crowded on weekends — come on a weekday morning. Adjacent Meiji Shrine deserves a separate half-day visit.

description.zh: 秋叶原是全球电子产品与动漫文化的麦加圣地，战后由电子零件黑市起家，今日已演变为集最新电器、动漫、游戏、扭蛋为一体的次文化中心。JR秋叶原站一带数百家店铺分布在多层楼高的大厦中，还有女仆咖啡馆、同人志专卖等特色体验。
description.en: Akihabara is the global mecca for electronics and anime culture, evolved from a post-war black market for electronic parts into a multi-storey labyrinth of consumer electronics, manga, games and gashapon capsule toys. Hundreds of shops cluster around JR Akihabara station, alongside maid cafés and doujinshi specialists.

zh: 动漫
电器
次文化
en: Anime
Electronics
Pop Culture

location.zh: 东京都千代田区外神田（秋叶原）

zh: Yodobashi Akiba：11层楼的大型电器综合商城，几乎涵盖所有电子产品
扭蛋会馆（Gachapon Kaikan）：日本最大的扭蛋专卖商场
Mandarake Complex：8层楼全品类中古动漫·游戏专卖店
en: Yodobashi Akiba: 11-storey electronics megastore stocking almost every gadget imaginable
Gachapon Kaikan: Japan's largest capsule-toy (gashapon) specialist shop
Mandarake Complex: 8 floors of second-hand anime, manga and games

tips.zh: 许多扭蛋机和小型店铺接受现金，建议随身携带硬币（100日元、500日元）。税免商店需持护照，可省去消费税。
tips.en: Many gashapon machines and small shops are cash-only — carry ¥100 and ¥500 coins. Tax-free shops require a passport and save you the consumption tax.

description.zh: 六本木融合了当代艺术、高端购物与繁华夜生活。六本木之丘的森美术馆以前卫展览闻名，东京城市观景台可远眺东京塔与富士山；东京中城则有21_21设计视觉馆和三多利美术馆，是东京最密集的文化综合体之一。
description.en: Roppongi blends contemporary art, luxury retail and vibrant nightlife. Roppongi Hills houses the Mori Art Museum, celebrated for cutting-edge exhibitions, and the Tokyo City View deck with sightlines to Tokyo Tower and Mt Fuji. Tokyo Midtown adds 21_21 Design Sight and the Suntory Museum of Art.

zh: 当代艺术
观景台
夜生活
en: Contemporary Art
Observation Deck
Nightlife

zh: 森美术馆：六本木之丘53楼，亚洲最具影响力的当代艺术空间之一
东京城市观景台：250米高，可同框拍摄东京塔与城市全景
毛利庭园：六本木之丘内的传统日式庭园，都市绿洲
en: Mori Art Museum: on the 53rd floor of Roppongi Hills, one of Asia's most influential contemporary art spaces
Tokyo City View: 250 m above ground — frame Tokyo Tower and the full skyline in one shot
Mōri Garden: traditional Japanese garden tucked inside Roppongi Hills, a quiet urban retreat

admission.zh: 森美术馆+观景台联票约1,800日元
admission.en: Mori Art Museum + City View combined ticket ~¥1,800

tips.zh: 六本木之丘观景台傍晚日落后至夜间是拍摄东京夜景的黄金时段。步行10分钟可抵达六本木另一大地标——东京中城。
tips.en: The observation deck is best visited from sunset through to night for Tokyo's famous glittering skyline. Tokyo Midtown is a 10-minute walk away for a second leg.

description.zh: 银座是东京最高端的购物与文化街区，19世纪末由明治政府打造为日本第一条西式街道，今日汇集了全球顶级品牌旗舰店与老牌百货。毗邻的筑地场外市场是品尝日本新鲜海鲜与街头美食的最佳场所。歌舞伎座是传统歌舞伎表演的殿堂。
description.en: Ginza is Tokyo's most prestigious shopping and cultural quarter, developed in the late 19th century as Japan's first Western-style street. Today it hosts global luxury flagship stores and venerable department stores. Nearby Tsukiji Outer Market is the best place to sample fresh seafood and street food. The Kabuki-za Theatre is the home of traditional kabuki performance.

zh: 购物
美食
传统艺术
en: Shopping
Food
Traditional Arts

location.zh: 东京都中央区银座·筑地

zh: 银座·和光钟楼：银座地标建筑（1932年），钟声每整点响起
筑地场外市场：玉子烧、新鲜生鱼片、海鲜串等东京最佳街头美食
歌舞伎座：传统歌舞伎剧场，可购单幕票体验
en: Ginza Wako: the 1932 clock tower landmark whose chimes mark every hour
Tsukiji Outer Market: best street food in Tokyo — tamagoyaki, fresh sashimi, seafood skewers
Kabuki-za Theatre: traditional-style theatre; single-act tickets available

admission.zh: 银座街区免费；歌舞伎全场约4,000—25,000日元，单幕约1,000—2,000日元
admission.en: Ginza streets free; Kabuki-za full programme ¥4,000–25,000; single-act ¥1,000–2,000

tips.zh: 筑地场外市场最佳时间是早上7—10点，届时摊位最新鲜且游客较少。歌舞伎单幕票（一幕见）无需预约，当天在剧场购买即可。
tips.en: Tsukiji Outer Market is at its freshest and least crowded between 7–10 am. Single-act kabuki tickets (hitomakumi) need no advance booking — buy them at the theatre on the day.

description.zh: 东京皇居坐落于江户城旧址，是日本天皇的居所。皇居外苑（广场）与皇居东御苑向公众开放，后者是原江户城天守阁所在地，今辟为精美日式庭园。东二重桥与石垣映衬下的护城河倒影是东京最具历史感的风景。
description.en: Tokyo's Imperial Palace occupies the site of Edo Castle and serves as the Emperor's residence. The outer plaza (Kokyo Gaien) and the Imperial Palace East Gardens are open to the public; the latter, once the site of Edo Castle's keep, is now a fine Japanese garden. The view of Nijubashi Bridge reflected in the palace moat is one of Tokyo's most evocative historic vistas.

zh: 历史
皇室
庭园
en: History
Imperial
Garden

location.zh: 东京都千代田区千代田

zh: 皇居东御苑：免费开放，原江户城本丸遗址，设有精心维护的日式庭园
二重桥：皇居最具代表性的摄影取景点，护城河倒影绝美
皇居外苑：环境优美的跑步圣地，约5公里一圈的皇居跑是世界知名路跑路线
en: East Gardens: free entry; the original Edo Castle honmaru grounds with manicured Japanese gardens
Nijubashi Bridge: the most iconic photo spot at the palace, with its perfect moat reflection
Outer plaza (Kokyo Gaien): a world-famous 5 km running loop around the palace

admission.zh: 皇居外苑和东御苑免费
admission.en: Outer plaza and East Gardens free

tips.zh: 东御苑周一、周五（及特定节假日）闭苑。每年1月2日（新年参贺）可入内参观，届时大批民众入苑庆贺。
tips.en: East Gardens is closed on Mondays and Fridays (and certain holidays). The palace interior opens for public access on 2 January (New Year greeting), drawing enormous crowds.

description.zh: 台场是东京湾上的人工岛，以前卫建筑、购物中心和科技体验著称。富士电视台球形建筑、自由女神像复制品、DiverCity购物中心外的等比例独角兽高达、teamLab数字艺术博物馆……台场是东京未来感最强的休闲区。
description.en: Odaiba is a futuristic man-made island in Tokyo Bay, known for avant-garde architecture, shopping malls and tech experiences. The spherical Fuji TV building, a Statue of Liberty replica, the life-size Unicorn Gundam at DiverCity, and the teamLab digital-art museum make this Tokyo's most otherworldly leisure zone.

zh: 未来感
购物
科技体验
en: Futuristic
Shopping
Tech Experience

zh: teamLab Planets/Borderless：沉浸式数字艺术，全球最具影响力的互动艺术体验之一
等比例独角兽高达：18米高的机动战士模型，每日定时进行灯光声效展示
日本科学未来馆：包含机器人、宇宙、地球科学等主题的综合科技博物馆
en: teamLab Planets/Borderless: immersive digital art — one of the world's most influential interactive art experiences
Life-size Unicorn Gundam: 18 m tall with scheduled light-and-sound shows
National Museum of Emerging Science and Innovation: robots, space and Earth-science exhibits

admission.zh: teamLab约3,200日元；未来馆约630日元；高达免费观看
admission.en: teamLab ~¥3,200; Miraikan ~¥630; Gundam free to view

tips.zh: 台场可乘坐无人驾驶的百合鸥号（Yurikamome）单轨列车从新桥站直达，车窗外的彩虹大桥和东京湾夜景极美，建议选择右侧座位。teamLab需提前在线预约。
tips.en: Take the driverless Yurikamome monorail from Shinbashi for stunning Rainbow Bridge views — sit on the right side. Book teamLab tickets online in advance.

description.zh: 池袋是东京西部最大的商业中心，JR池袋站与私铁车站连为一体，构成全球第二繁忙的车站枢纽。阳光城60层观景台、宝可梦中心等主题商业，以及动漫文化商店鳞次栉比，尤其是北部的乙女路（Otome Road）以少女向动漫商品而闻名。
description.en: Ikebukuro is western Tokyo's largest commercial hub, with JR and private-line stations forming the world's second-busiest station complex. Sunshine 60's observation deck, the Pokémon Center, and dense anime retail — especially the 'Otome Road' strip catering to female fans — make this a major draw for pop-culture visitors.

zh: 动漫文化
购物
观景台
en: Anime Culture
Shopping
Observation Deck

zh: 阳光60观景台（展望パーク）：60层室外观景平台，可眺望新宿和富士山
宝可梦中心大型东京店：全系列宝可梦官方商品，含限定款
乙女路（Otome Road）：少女向动漫周边、同人志、声优商品专卖区
en: Sunshine 60 TENBOU-PARK: outdoor sky deck atop the 60-storey landmark, with Shinjuku and Mt Fuji views
Pokémon Center Mega Tokyo: full Pokémon official merchandise range including exclusives
Otome Road: anime, voice-actor goods and doujinshi shops catering to female fans

tips.zh: 池袋东口（东武百货侧）较为商业化，西口（西武百货侧）风格更具生活气息。阳光城地下商场（Sunshine City）面积极大，建议预留额外时间。
tips.en: The East Exit (Tobu department store side) is the mainstream commercial zone; West Exit (Seibu side) is more neighbourhood-flavoured. Sunshine City's underground mall is vast — allow extra time.

name.zh: 三鹰吉卜力美术馆·吉祥寺

description.zh: 三鹰之森吉卜力美术馆是宫崎骏亲自设计监修的主题博物馆，充满动画世界的奇幻细节，屋顶上矗立着《天空之城》的机器兵。毗邻的井の头公园与吉祥寺是东京最受年轻人喜爱的生活风格街区，特立独行的古着店与咖啡馆密布其间。
description.en: The Ghibli Museum in Mitaka was personally designed and supervised by Hayao Miyazaki, filled with whimsical animation details and crowned by a rooftop robot from Castle in the Sky. Nearby Inokashira Park and Kichijoji are among Tokyo's most beloved neighbourhood destinations, lined with vintage clothing stores and independent cafés.

location.zh: 东京都三鹰市·武蔵野市（吉祥寺）

zh: 三鹰之森吉卜力美术馆：宫崎骏亲自参与设计，含独家放映室与屋顶机器兵
井の头恩賜公园：以吉祥寺为中心的大型城市公园，樱花期与游船极受欢迎
吉祥寺中道商业街：独立咖啡馆、古着店与特色小店云集的东京潮流街区
en: Ghibli Museum: Miyazaki-designed; exclusive short films screened inside plus the rooftop Laputa robot
Inokashira Park: large urban park centred on Kichijoji, beloved for sakura viewing and rowboat hire
Kichijoji Nakamichi arcade: independent cafés, vintage stores and character shops in a charming covered street

admission.zh: 吉卜力美术馆1,000日元（需提前购票，仅限定期抽签或指定渠道）；公园免费
admission.en: Ghibli Museum ¥1,000 (advance timed-entry ticket required — ballot system); park free

tips.zh: 吉卜力美术馆门票通过官网抽签或Lawson便利店购买，往往在发售首日售罄，需提前数月关注。从三鷹站步行约15分钟，或乘坐往返的免费Ghibli巴士。
tips.en: Ghibli Museum tickets sell out the same day they go on sale (via ballot at the official site or Lawson convenience stores) — check months ahead. Walk 15 minutes from Mitaka station, or take the free Ghibli bus.

description.zh: 高尾山（599米）距新宿仅约50分钟车程，却保留着原始的杉木林与丰富的野生动植物，每年登山者逾300万人次，号称「全球登山人数最多的山」。山腰的高尾山薬王院是奉火伏不动明王的天台宗古刹，更为登山增添了精神意涵。
description.en: Mt Takao (599 m), just 50 minutes from Shinjuku, retains old-growth cedar forest and rich wildlife, drawing over 3 million visitors per year — making it reportedly the world's most-climbed mountain. The mid-mountain Takaosan Yakuo-in temple adds a spiritual dimension to the hike.

location.zh: 东京都八王子市高尾町

zh: 登山路线多样：最短1号路约2.5公里，最长4号路穿越吊桥，各适合不同体力
秋叶红叶：11月中旬至12月上旬，漫山红叶被誉为东京近郊最美秋景
晴天富士山展望：山顶天气晴好时可清晰望见富士山
en: Multiple hiking trails: Trail 1 (2.5 km, easiest) to Trail 4 (suspension bridge route) — suited to all abilities
Autumn foliage: mid-November to early December, hailed as one of Tokyo's finest autumn colour destinations
Mt Fuji views: on clear days the summit offers unobstructed views of Mt Fuji

admission.zh: 登山免费；缆车往返约1,000日元
admission.en: Hiking free; cable car round trip ~¥1,000

tips.zh: 从新宿乘京王电铁特急约47分钟至高尾山口站，无需换乘。周末和紫藤花、红叶旺季人潮极多，建议工作日前往。
tips.en: Take the Keio Railway Ltd. Express from Shinjuku — 47 minutes to Takaosanguchi, no transfer needed. Avoid weekends and peak foliage/wisteria seasons; weekdays are far less crowded.

description.zh: 东京晴空塔以634米之高成为日本第一高塔，拥有天望甲板（350米）和天望回廊（450米）两个观景层，晴天时可望见富士山、关东平原乃至远处的山岳。塔下的晴空街道综合体和隅田公园使这一区域成为东京东部重要的观光地。
description.en: Tokyo Skytree, at 634 m, is Japan's tallest structure, with two observation floors: the Tembo Deck (350 m) and the Tembo Galleria (450 m). On clear days views extend to Mt Fuji and the Kanto Plain. The base complex Skytree Town and adjacent Sumida Park round out this major east Tokyo attraction.

zh: 展望台
地标建筑
东京夜景
en: Observation Deck
Landmark

zh: 天望甲板（350米）：全景俯瞰东京，夜景尤为壮观
天望回廊（450米）：玻璃地板走廊，脚下即是城市
隅田公园：春季约600株樱树与晴空塔同框，东京最美赏樱地点之一
en: Tembo Deck (350 m): 360° Tokyo panorama — city-light views at night are spectacular
Tembo Galleria (450 m): glass-floored skybridge for vertigo-inducing views straight down
Sumida Park: ~600 cherry trees framing the Skytree in spring — one of Tokyo's finest hanami spots

admission.zh: 天望甲板约2,100日元；天望回廊加收约1,000日元

tips.zh: 建议日落前1小时入场，可同时欣赏白天全景与点亮后的夜景。周末需提前在线预约时间段，现场排队等待时间较长。
tips.en: Arrive one hour before sunset to enjoy both the daytime view and the city lighting up. Book a timed entry slot online on weekends — walk-up queues can be very long.
